A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (stat boxes and corrected game text), meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-tuskenraider-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Tusken Raider]]: The game text changes: “Deploys only on Tatooine. Power +1 if another non-unique Tusken Raider present. If you have four or more non-unique Tusken Raiders present, your” is added; “of a group of Tusken Raiders depends on how many are present. One has a total power of 1, two = 3, three = 6, four = 10. Limit of four at one site. Deploy only to Tatooine, but may move elsewhere.” becomes “here is +2.”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with a title and a white italic “E”.

The same area of the printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
